text:
sasha: Heads-up — scheduled maintenance in az1 on Tue 2026-03-25 02:00-05:00 UTC. We're swapping thermal fans in racks A3-A6. Plan: rolling node drains per-rack (~10-15% GPU capacity reduction per cohort). Expect ~30–45m per rack including warm-up. Will route traffic with autoscaler + fallback. Posting action items and cost tradeoffs below. Please ack if you have customer-facing jobs that conflict.

aj: Ack. Which exact pools get touched? service tags?

sasha: Affected pools: `gpu-pool-az1-highprio`, `gpu-pool-az1-default`. We will avoid touching `gpu-pool-az1-burst` except if backfill required. Cordoning/drain command will be: `fleetctl drain --cohort=A3 --grace=300`. Canary on A3 first.

devon: Recommend canary include 2 nodes (not just 1) to validate NVLink + kv-cache rehydrate. Also suggest `--evict-local-pods=false` so prefix cache stays warm where possible.

infra-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MNT-3421. Customer notifications scheduled for 00:30 UTC (customers with >1h SLA).

kevin: Ops Q: autoscaler fallback to other region (us-east1) will be allowed? That might spike egress and spot costs.

sasha: Autoscaler policy: prefer local region. After 15m of capacity shortfall it may fallback to us-east1. We set `cost_hedge=true` so fallback only if warm-burst budget <20%. Estimated cost if fallback used: ~$7k–$12k for the 3h window (depends on spot churn).

aj: Could we pre-warm a tiny warm pool in az1 to avoid cross-region fallback? Cost vs risk tradeoff?

devon: Pre-warm 4x A100 equivalents for 3h ~= $1.6k — much cheaper than cross-region egress. I recommend pre-warm. Also set affinity to avoid bursting into constrained racks.

oncall: I'll own canary monitoring during the window. I will watch p99 latency, job fail-rate, and NVLink error counters. I'll post alerts to #incidents if any regression > 2x baseline.

sasha: Action items: devon to provision pre-warm by 01:30 UTC (`az1-warm-4`), infra-bot to send customer comms at 00:30, oncall to monitor and hold connection for rollback. If no objections I'll start canary at 02:00.

kevin: +1 to pre-warm. Also add rollback criteria: if NVLink error rate or OOMs spike to >2 nodes in a cohort within 20 minutes, pause and revert.

aj: Noted. Please add a short runbook step to MNT-3421 for rollback and who to page.

devon: Pre-warm command I used in staging:
```
fleetctl provision --pool=az1-warm-4 --gpu=4 --ttl=03h --affinity=avoid:A3
```
Will run this at 01:30 and report back.

sasha: I'll update MNT-3421 with the runbook snippet and the cost estimate. TY all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: customer comm at 00:30 UTC, canary start at 02:00 UTC, full roll at 02:30 if canary clean.
